about: VCST-6122 large labelled set (2026-10-05): 300 real asks drawn from the base logs on main (2026-09-18..10-05; stratified by who x ask state; already-labelled and near-duplicate questions removed; wave runs excluded). Candidates per question = verdict top 10 + floor-1 top 3 + BM25 top 8 over bodies (scripts/kb/bench/label-packets.mjs). Labelled by two independent Claude passes with shuffled candidates; the 33 disagreements adjudicated by a third; the operator audits a random sample. Split BY ENTRY GROUP: a group that holds an entry already split in v2 keeps that split, the rest by a seeded hash (logs300-seed-1); controls by row hash. contested rows stay out of every metric. Questions logged by a pre-#328 client with a Git Bash path rewrite (C:/Program Files/Git/<route>) are stored repaired, as ask now repairs them before ranking; the logged text is kept in qAsLogged. Validated after labelling: 10 rows removed (listed in removed[]): 4 same-intent repeats beyond two per entry, 6 questions about our own test fixtures or environment availability rather than platform behaviour.
